title: User supplying a fake vault can steal protocol assets as a grief attack
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as a malicious actor can drain protocol assets  **Likelihood:** Low, as it is a common attack vector and it requires no preconditions  ## Description  The `_vault` argument in the `repay` method (and in all others) has no input validation, meaning a user can supply a fake vault which he himself created.
